note: Per-fighter hash over the COMPLETE FIGHT_HISTORY value. Detects changes to any bout, including middle records, which the roster manifest summary cannot. Derived directly from src/fightHistory.js; independent of any capture.
joinNote: expectedRosterHistoryHash is what the in-browser roster manifest historyHashes/rosterHistoryHash MUST equal. Independently derived here from identityKeys + src/fightHistory.js + sortHistoryDesc -- NOT adopted from a browser capture. verifyFixtures.cjs REQUIRES every candidate to provide and match it. This is the guard against Stage 3 attaching a history to the wrong fighter.
